user_story: As a user, I want to filter tasks by category so that I can focus on a specific area.

positive.title: Filter tasks by selecting a valid category
steps: Navigate to the task management page.
Select a category from the 'Filter by Category' dropdown.
positive.expected_result: Tasks displayed are only from the selected category.

negative.title: Filter tasks by selecting an non-existent category
steps: Navigate to the task management page.
Manually enter a non-existent category name in the filter input.
negative.expected_result: No tasks are displayed and an error message 'Category not found' appears.

edge.title: Filter tasks with an empty category input
steps: Navigate to the task management page.
Clear any selected category in the 'Filter by Category' dropdown so that it is empty.
edge.expected_result: All tasks are displayed as no specific category filter is applied.
